lines.zh: 铁轨在爪下叮当作响，我贴着墙走。
lines.en: The rails clink under my claws; I hug the wall.

lines.zh: 蛛网挂在头顶，我从下面钻过去。
lines.en: Cobwebs hang overhead, and I slip beneath them.

lines.zh: 矿道很窄，我侧着身子往前走。
lines.en: The tunnel is narrow, so I walk sideways.

lines.zh: 我踩过腐木板，声音闷在黑暗里。
lines.en: My steps cross rotten planks, muffled by the dark.

lines.zh: 砂砾滚下斜坡，我跟着滑了一小段。
lines.en: Gravel rolls down the slope and I slide after it.

lines.zh: 我沿着矿车轨道小跑，尾巴擦着铁。
lines.en: I trot along the minecart rails, tail brushing iron.

lines.zh: 滴水声在前面，我转了个弯。
lines.en: Water drips ahead, so I turn the corner.

lines.zh: 矿灯早就灭了，我还认得这条路。
lines.en: The mine lamps died long ago; I still know this road.

lines.zh: 我绕开塌陷的坑，脚步没有停。
lines.en: I skirt the collapsed pit without breaking stride.

lines.zh: 木支架在响，我加快了一点。
lines.en: The timber supports creak, so I quicken my pace.

lines.zh: 黑暗中我只剩一点轮廓，很好藏。
lines.en: In the dark I am only an outline, easy to hide.

lines.zh: 我踩着自己的回声，一节一节前进。
lines.en: I follow my own echo, rail by rail.

lines.zh: 废弃矿井的风从背后吹来，我压低身子。
lines.en: Wind from the abandoned shaft pushes me low.

lines.zh: 我钻过断裂的横梁，没有碰响它。
lines.en: I slip through a broken beam without rattling it.

lines.zh: 我踩着枕木间的空隙走。
lines.en: I step through the gaps between the sleepers.

lines.zh: 矿车的轮子还在响，我让开。
lines.en: The cart wheels still creak; I step aside.

lines.zh: 我蹲在枕木上，听矿井深处的动静。
lines.en: I crouch on a sleeper and listen to the deep mine.

lines.zh: 我把鼻尖贴到铁轨上，那里还有余温。
lines.en: I press my nose to the rail; it still holds warmth.

lines.zh: 我在黑暗里眨眼，眼睛很快适应了。
lines.en: I blink in the dark, and my eyes adjust fast.

lines.zh: 一小块砂砾滚下来，我看着它停住。
lines.en: A pebble rolls down, and I watch it stop.

lines.zh: 我在废弃矿井里长大，不怕这种安静。
lines.en: I grew up in this mine; the silence does not scare me.

lines.zh: 我理了理毛，蛛网黏在耳朵上。
lines.en: I groom my fur; a cobweb sticks to my ear.

lines.zh: 我打了个小哈欠，又竖起耳朵。
lines.en: I yawn small, then prick my ears again.

lines.zh: 头顶的水滴落在我背上，我抖了抖。
lines.en: A drop lands on my back and I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我数着矿道的回声，一共七下。
lines.en: I count the echoes down the tunnel: seven.

lines.zh: 横梁的影子投下来，我坐在影子里。
lines.en: A beam casts its shadow, and I sit inside it.

lines.zh: 我把爪子收在身下，静静等着。
lines.en: I tuck my paws under me and wait quietly.

lines.zh: 远处有石头松动，我抬起头听。
lines.en: Something shifts far away; I lift my head to listen.

lines.zh: 我在铁轨边磨爪子，声音很轻。
lines.en: I sharpen my claws on the rail, very softly.

lines.zh: 我盯着矿道的尽头，那里什么都没有。
lines.en: I stare down the tunnel, where nothing waits.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴绕在铁轨上取暖。
lines.en: I wrap my tail around the rail for warmth.

lines.zh: 洞顶渗水，一滴一滴数着。
lines.en: Water seeps from the roof, drip by drip.

lines.zh: 你站在矿道口，我抬起头看你。
lines.en: You stand at the shaft mouth; I lift my head.

lines.zh: 你身上有外面的味道，我闻得出来。
lines.en: You smell of the surface; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我不退，只是把身子压低了一点。
lines.en: I do not retreat; I only crouch a little lower.

lines.zh: 你手里的灯晃得我眼睛发疼。
lines.en: Your lamp swings and stings my eyes.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，猜你会不会伸手。
lines.en: I tilt my head, guessing whether you will reach out.

lines.zh: 我在矿井里见过很多人，大多不温柔。
lines.en: I have met many people down here; most were not gentle.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声太整齐，不像矿工。
lines.en: Your steps are too even to belong to a miner.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的靴子，上面全是外面的泥。
lines.en: I stare at your boots, caked with surface mud.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来了，我就没那么紧张。
lines.en: You crouch down, and my tension eases.

lines.zh: 我眨了一下眼，又眨了一下。
lines.en: I blink once, then blink again.

lines.zh: 你在黑暗里找我，其实我在你脚边。
lines.en: You search the dark for me; I am at your feet.

lines.zh: 我从废矿井里看你，像看一个出口。
lines.en: I look at you from the mine, like an exit.

lines.zh: 我疼得缩成一团，躲进木板缝。
lines.en: The pain curls me up, and I squeeze into a plank gap.

lines.zh: 我没想到矿井外的东西也这么快。
lines.en: I did not think things outside the mine were this quick.

lines.zh: 我腿上破了口，跑起来一跳一跳。
lines.en: My leg is cut, and I run in little hops.

lines.zh: 我尖叫一声，矿道把它拉得很长。
lines.en: I shriek once, and the tunnel stretches it long.

lines.zh: 我一边退一边看你，怕你还要打。
lines.en: I retreat while watching you, afraid of another blow.

lines.zh: 这点伤比不上塌方，但我还是发抖。
lines.en: This is less than a cave-in, yet I still tremble.

lines.zh: 我舔着伤口，嘴里全是铁锈味。
lines.en: I lick the wound; my mouth tastes of rust.

lines.zh: 我钻进枕木底下，只露出眼睛。
lines.en: I crawl under a sleeper and show only my eyes.

lines.zh: 我还没学会不怕疼。
lines.en: I have not yet learned to ignore pain.

lines.zh: 别打了，我已经很小了。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; I am already small enough.

lines.zh: 你手心里的东西，我闻了三遍。
lines.en: I sniff what lies in your palm three times over.

lines.zh: 我靠近一步，又退回半步。
lines.en: I step closer, then give half a step back.

lines.zh: 这东西比矿井里的苔藓香。
lines.en: This smells better than the moss in the mine.

lines.zh: 我把爪子搭在你鞋尖上，试探着。
lines.en: I rest my paw on your boot tip, testing.

lines.zh: 你不动，我才敢把头伸过去。
lines.en: You hold still, so I dare to reach my head over.

lines.zh: 我小口咬住，眼睛还看着你。
lines.en: I take a small bite while watching you.

lines.zh: 矿井里可没有这种味道。
lines.en: Nothing tastes like this down in the mine.

lines.zh: 我吃得太急，被呛了一下。
lines.en: I eat too fast and choke a little.

lines.zh: 尾巴自己翘起来了，我控制不住。
lines.en: My tail lifts on its own; I cannot stop it.

lines.zh: 你蹲得越低，我靠得越近。
lines.en: The lower you crouch, the closer I come.

lines.zh: 我把食物拖到枕木后面再吃。
lines.en: I drag the food behind a sleeper to eat.

lines.zh: 我信任你一点点，就一点点。
lines.en: I trust you a little, only a little.

lines.zh: 这块够我藏进矿井深处慢慢啃。
lines.en: This is enough to hide deep in the mine and gnaw.

lines.zh: 你伸来的手没有恶意，我闻得出来。
lines.en: The hand you offer means no harm; I can tell.

lines.zh: 你把食物放在铁轨上，我等着。
lines.en: You set the food on the rail, and I wait.

lines.zh: 我闻出这不是矿里的东西。
lines.en: I can tell this isn't from the mine.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我一下钻到铁轨底下。
lines.en: You bump me and I dart beneath the rails.

lines.zh: 我太矮了，你差点踩着我。
lines.en: I am so low you nearly step on me.

lines.zh: 我被挤到墙边，毛都竖起来。
lines.en: Pushed to the wall, my fur stands on end.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我才从木板缝里探头。
lines.en: You step back, and I peek from the plank gap.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我想起塌方的声音。
lines.en: That bump reminds me of a cave-in.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边绕开，没敢叫。
lines.en: I veer around your feet without a sound.

lines.zh: 矿井太窄，总有一个要让路。
lines.en: The tunnel is narrow; one of us must yield.

lines.zh: 我蹭了你一下，算是道歉。
lines.en: I brush against you, which is my apology.

lines.zh: 你鞋底离我太近，我缩成一团。
lines.en: Your sole comes too close, so I curl up.

lines.zh: 我被撞得转了个圈，又站稳了。
lines.en: The bump spins me around; then I steady myself.

lines.zh: 我从矿井深处叫了一声，等回应。
lines.en: I call from deep in the mine and wait for an answer.

lines.zh: 另一只从轨道那头跑来，脚步很轻。
lines.en: Another comes running down the rails, light-footed.

lines.zh: 我们互相闻了闻，就安静下来了。
lines.en: We sniff each other, then go quiet.

lines.zh: 我把藏起来的食物推给它。
lines.en: I push my hoarded food toward it.

lines.zh: 两只小异宠挤在枕木上，很暖。
lines.en: Two small critters crowd one sleeper, warm.

lines.zh: 它舔了舔我的耳朵，我闭上眼睛。
lines.en: It licks my ear, and I close my eyes.

lines.zh: 我们打算在废矿井最深处安家。
lines.en: We mean to settle in the deepest part of the mine.

lines.zh: 我绕着他转圈，尾巴扫起灰。
lines.en: I circle him, tail sweeping up dust.

lines.zh: 这矿井太大了，两只也不算多。
lines.en: This mine is vast; even two of us are few.

lines.zh: 我轻声叫，它也跟着叫。
lines.en: I call softly, and it answers.

lines.zh: 你把我捧起来，我僵了一瞬。
lines.en: You lift me up, and I freeze for a moment.

lines.zh: 我闻到你的袖子，是外面的空气。
lines.en: I smell your sleeve; it carries outside air.

lines.zh: 我缩在你掌心里，比矿井暖。
lines.en: I curl in your palm, warmer than the mine.

lines.zh: 我挣了一下，又不动了。
lines.en: I squirm once, then hold still.

lines.zh: 铁轨在下面变远，我有点晕。
lines.en: The rails grow distant below, and I feel dizzy.

lines.zh: 你抱得太紧，我轻轻咬你一口。
lines.en: You hold too tight, so I nip you lightly.

lines.zh: 我趴在你肩上，往后看矿道。
lines.en: I perch on your shoulder and look back at the tunnel.

lines.zh: 我爪子勾住你的衣角，怕掉下去。
lines.en: My claws hook your hem, afraid of falling.

lines.zh: 第一次离开矿井，我耳朵贴着头。
lines.en: Leaving the mine for the first time, my ears flatten.

lines.zh: 你把我放下来，我还是跟着你。
lines.en: You set me down, and I still follow.

lines.zh: 那边有东西在动，我停下脚步。
lines.en: Something moves over there, and I stop walking.

lines.zh: 我听见矿道里有第二组脚步。
lines.en: I hear a second set of footsteps in the tunnel.

lines.zh: 我竖起耳朵，把身子贴向地面。
lines.en: I raise my ears and press my body to the floor.

lines.zh: 那个影子挡住了唯一的出口。
lines.en: That shadow blocks the only way out.

lines.zh: 我认出这种脚步，不是来喂我的。
lines.en: I know that gait; it is not here to feed me.

lines.zh: 我往轨道后面缩，眼睛没离开它。
lines.en: I shrink behind the rails without looking away.

lines.zh: 矿井的安静被它踩碎了。
lines.en: It tramples the mine's quiet into pieces.

lines.zh: 我发出很低的咕噜声，给它警告。
lines.en: I give a low growl as a warning.

lines.zh: 我记住它的位置，然后慢慢后退。
lines.en: I mark its position, then back away slowly.

lines.zh: 你在我旁边，我胆子大了一点。
lines.en: With you beside me, I feel a little braver.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，尾巴一下一下敲地。
lines.en: I stare at it, tail tapping the ground.

lines.zh: 它每靠近一步，我就退半步。
lines.en: With each step it takes, I give half a step.

lines.zh: 我先等它动，再决定跑。
lines.en: I wait for it to move before I decide to run.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很浅，爪子已经张开。
lines.en: My breath is shallow and my claws are out.

lines.zh: 我绕向它侧面，那里有块松动的石头。
lines.en: I edge toward its flank, where a stone sits loose.

lines.zh: 它看不清我，黑暗是矿井给我的。
lines.en: It cannot see me; the dark is the mine's gift.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了会暴露位置。
lines.en: I stay silent; a call would give me away.

lines.zh: 我数着它的脚步，等一个空档。
lines.en: I count its steps and wait for a gap.

lines.zh: 你退后，我知道你要动手了。
lines.en: You step back; I know you are about to act.

lines.zh: 我把身子压到最低，随时能跑。
lines.en: I flatten myself low, ready to bolt.

lines.zh: 我扑上去咬住它的脚踝。
lines.en: I leap and sink my teeth into its ankle.

lines.zh: 我太小了，只能用牙和速度。
lines.en: I am too small for anything but teeth and speed.

lines.zh: 我从枕木下窜出，撞它的腿弯。
lines.en: I burst from under a sleeper and hit its knee.

lines.zh: 我咬一口就退，矿井教会我的。
lines.en: Bite once and retreat: that is what the mine taught me.

lines.zh: 我的爪刮过它的皮，留下白痕。
lines.en: My claws rake its hide and leave a pale line.

lines.zh: 它转身太慢，我已经钻到背后。
lines.en: It turns too slowly; I am already behind it.

lines.zh: 我尖叫着扑过去，声音在矿道里炸开。
lines.en: I shriek and lunge, my cry bursting down the tunnel.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，直到它甩开我。
lines.en: I hold my bite until it throws me off.

lines.zh: 我被撞飞，落地又冲向它。
lines.en: Knocked away, I land and charge again.

lines.zh: 这一下为了矿井，也为了你。
lines.en: This one is for the mine, and for you.

lines.zh: 我从废弃矿井的阴影里醒来。
lines.en: I wake in the shadow of the abandoned mine.

lines.zh: 铁轨在脚下，我知道该往哪走。
lines.en: Rails underfoot, and I know which way to go.

lines.zh: 这里塌过很多次，我还是选了这个角落。
lines.en: This place has caved in before; I still chose this corner.

lines.zh: 我抖掉背上的灰，看向矿道深处。
lines.en: I shake the dust off my back and look deeper in.

lines.zh: 我在腐木板下睁眼，四周很黑。
lines.en: I open my eyes under rotten planks, in deep dark.

lines.zh: 矿道里多了一点小动静，那是我。
lines.en: A small sound joins the tunnel; that is me.

lines.zh: 我出生在砂砾堆边，第一口吃了灰。
lines.en: Born by a gravel heap, I ate dust first.

lines.zh: 我试探着走两步，铁轨冰凉。
lines.en: I test two steps; the rails are cold.

lines.zh: 上面的世界还在很远的地方。
lines.en: The world above is still very far away.

lines.zh: 我在这里等一个愿意弯腰的人。
lines.en: I wait here for someone willing to stoop.

lines.zh: 毛尖烧焦的味道，我满地打滚。
lines.en: My fur tips burn, and I roll on the ground.

lines.zh: 我摔在砂砾上，骨头都在响。
lines.en: I hit the gravel, and my bones rattle.

lines.zh: 矿井的积水灌进鼻子，我乱蹬。
lines.en: Mine water floods my nose, and I kick wildly.

lines.zh: 塌方的声音回来了，我抱头趴下。
lines.en: The sound of a cave-in returns; I cover my head.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我旁边的木板上。
lines.en: An arrow pins itself into the plank beside me.

lines.zh: 奇怪的光缠住我，我甩不掉。
lines.en: Strange light wraps me, and I cannot shake it.

lines.zh: 矿井里没有吃的，我肚子贴着背。
lines.en: There is no food in the mine; my belly is flat.

lines.zh: 雷声顺着矿道滚进来，我耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Thunder rolls down the tunnel, and my ears ring.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: There is nothing below, and I catch nothing.
